chain.title: Fold a Paper Lantern
chain.desc: Paper, a torch, an iron nugget and a wooden slab - the cheapest thing in the set and a light source. Everything else in the lantern family is this one lantern plus a dye, a stick, bamboo or a sapling.

chain.title: Build the Froggy Chair
chain.desc: A bamboo block and lime dye. You can actually sit on it, and four more dye colours exist. One per seat you want at a table.

chain.title: Upholster a Moroccan Sofa
chain.desc: Red and green wool over a dark oak log. Wider than the chairs and also sittable, so it is the piece for a living room.

chain.title: Set a Desk Mirror
chain.desc: A glass pane on a wooden slab. Oak, spruce and dark oak versions exist so it matches whatever the rest of the room is built from.

chain.title: Plumb a Shower
chain.desc: Iron, a chain and a stone button. Pairs with the Bathroom Rack and the Washing Machine to finish a bathroom; none of the three do anything mechanical.

chain.title: Forge a Cast Iron Trapdoor
chain.desc: Pure iron and thinner than the vanilla trapdoor. Along with the Cast Iron Ledge it is the only structural piece the mod adds, meant for balconies and stairwells.

chain.title: Lay Monochrome Tiles
chain.desc: Blackstone and quartz. Black Monochrome Bricks and the pale Monochrome Bricks checkerboard against each other, which is what makes this mod's cafes and bathrooms read as tiled floors - make both, in quantity.

chain.title: Install a Cash Register
chain.desc: Paper, iron, redstone and stone. Clicking it plays a ka-ching - it is shop dressing, not a working till. Dye it black or gray if the counter needs it.

chain.title: Wall-Mount an ATM
chain.desc: Iron, redstone and a stone button, two blocks tall. Craft the black one first; green, yellow, red and blue are just that one dyed.

chain.title: Build the Gacha Machine
chain.desc: Iron, redstone, glass, an egg and a button. This is the only block in the mod that actually does something, and it is the sole source of two dozen items - build one before you go collecting.

chain.title: Feed the Machine a Diamond
chain.desc: Right-click the Gacha Machine holding a diamond and it spits out a capsule. Diamonds are the only accepted currency, so budget one diamond per pull.

chain.title: Crack Open Capsules
chain.desc: Right-click a capsule for one random item from the gacha pool - plushies, gnomes, lawn mowers, toy planes, globes, the waving Lucky Cat. None of these 24 blocks has a crafting recipe, so pulling capsules is the only way to get any of them, and which one you get is pure luck: budget several diamonds if you are after a specific piece.

chain.title: Mount the Netherite Curio Register
chain.desc: A netherite block, a netherite ingot and a lever. Iron, copper and gold versions cost far less and look nearly the same, so make this one last, when you are decorating for show.

collections.name: Gacha-exclusive blocks
collections.note: Exactly the 24 values of the whimsy_deco:gatcha_drops item tag. NONE of these have a crafting recipe - the Gacha Machine is the only source. Never generate a craft quest for any of them. whimsy_deco:lantern_gnome is deliberately NOT in this list: it has no recipe AND is absent from the tag, so it cannot be obtained at all.

collections.name: Paper lantern variants
collections.note: All are the base paper_lantern plus one extra ingredient.

collections.name: Cash registers
collections.note: The plain register dyes into black and gray; the four Curio registers are a separate vanilla-metal tier ladder.

collections.name: Phones
collections.note: phone dyed black, red or blue.

collections.name: Odds and ends
collections.note: Flat one-step crafts from vanilla materials with no dependencies between them.

notes: THIS IS A DECORATION MOD, not a tech mod. 88 blocks plus one item (the Gacha Capsule), 64 recipes, no advancements, no loot tables beyond block self-drops, no worldgen, no structures. There is exactly ONE mechanic in the whole jar: GachaponMachineBlock takes an item from the whimsy_deco:gatcha_machine_accepts tag (which contains only minecraft:diamond) and returns a whimsy_deco:gatcha_capsule; GatchaCapsuleItem then rolls one random entry from the whimsy_deco:gatcha_drops tag. The 24 ids listed in the Gacha-exclusive collection have NO crafting recipe anywhere in the jar - the machine is their only source, so a craft quest for any of them is uncompletable. whimsy_deco:lantern_gnome is a trap: it looks like one of the gnome variants but it has neither a recipe nor a place in the gatcha_drops tag, so it is unobtainable in survival and must never appear in a quest. Every one of the 89 blocks does have a self-drop loot table, so anything craftable is also re-collectable. The ATMs and cash registers are cosmetic despite the 'Purchasing' JEI category: ATMBlock has no interaction logic and CashRegisterBlock only plays a sound, so do not write quests implying you can buy or store anything with them. The chain above is therefore a suggested BUILD ORDER by vanilla material cost (paper/wood -> iron -> diamond -> netherite), not a tech tree; the only genuine dependency edges in the jar are paper_lantern -> its five variants, cash_register -> its two dyes, black_atm -> its four dyes, and gatcha_machine -> gatcha_capsule -> the gacha pool. Several blocks are two blocks tall (ATM, Gacha Machine, Shower) via MultiblockHandler.
